Drone Flight Documents

- [**Flight Standards**](flight_standards.html) — Planning and naming conventions for drone flights.
- [**Pre-Flight Checklist**](flight_checklist.html) — Online field checklist excerpted from Flight Standards.
- [**Flight Log Tracker**](flight_tracker.html) — How to use the standalone flight-log tracking app.
- [**How To Get Your Part 107 Certificate**](part_107.html) — Steps for obtaining a Part 107 remote pilot certificate.
- [**Link to flight planner GitHub**](https://github.com/cojow/flight_planner) — How to download and use the flight planner.

Processing the Images

- [**Point Cloud Maker**](https://cojow.github.io/point_cloud_maker/) - Companion repository. For extracting buildings from drone images


Using the drones outside the US

- [**Ecuador Drone (UAS) Laws — Notes**](Flying_in_Ecuador/ecuador_drone_laws.html) — Compiled notes on import tax, general operating rules, insurance, and flight considerations.
- [**Traveling with Drones**](Flying_in_Ecuador/flying_with_drones.html) — Compiled notes on rules and regulations for transporting drones.
- [**Flying UAS/Drones in Ecuador for Academic Research**](Flying_in_Ecuador/Ecuador_UAS_Research_Guide.pdf) (PDF) — A translated, cited guide to RDAC 101 and related Ecuadorian law, for a foreign graduate researcher.
